thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden spike in embeddings traffic from clustered IPs (ASN: 7018). 60k reqs/min, error budget chewing. Potential scraper/credential-stuffing pattern. Auto-ticket #INC-3891 created.
sarah: paging oncall - looks like embeddings async batch endpoint is being hammered. can someone take live?
ops-oncall: on it. will verify source + apply short-term shields.
ops-oncall: quick checks - source prefix 3.5.246.0/24 and related ASN. many requests with identical user_agent headers. suspect bot farm.
ops-oncall: applying temporary rate-slice rule (rls) for embeddings: 
```
rls apply --route /v1/embeddings/async --match ip_prefix=3.5.246.0/24 --limit 10rpm --duration 15m --reason "scraper surge"
```
ops-oncall: enabling WAF tarpit for IP range wf-rule=wf-472, tarpit-delay=10s. returning 503 for large fanout patterns.
eli: +1 on tarpit. also recommend blocking suspicious ASN on CDN edge and bumping captcha threshold for new API keys.
sarah: product impact? raj, can you triage which customers are affected and if any critical SLAs are at risk?
raj: running quick query. looks like three smaller SaaS customers saw 30-40% embedding failures in last 5m. no top-tier customers currently impacted. sending heads-up to those accounts.
ops-oncall: WAF rule and rls both active. immediate ingestion rate down 85% from spike. CPU on embed-pool stable.
ops-oncall: note: disabled async batch endpoint for unknown/unauthenticated requests as emergency measure: 
```
k8s patch deployment embeddings-async --env=DISABLE_UNAUTH_BATCH=true
```
jess: flagged in product channel to pause non-critical background embedding jobs. customers with scheduled jobs might see delays. drafting short notice.
raj: customer comms ready. minimal language: "We've detected suspicious automated traffic affecting embedding throughput; we've applied mitigations and will update you if your jobs are affected."
eli: security note - saving raw request headers + sample payloads to S3 for follow-up. creating IOC list for blocking rules.
sarah: thanks team. handoff at 3891234580 to night oncall (mike). mike - summary: WAF tarpit wf-472 active, RLS on /v1/embeddings/async for 3.5.246.0/24, unauth batch disabled, CDN block for ASN 7018 queued (propagating). customer comms drafted.
ops-oncall: monitoring dashboards: token failures trending down; latency normalized. will keep rls for 30m and reassess.
mike: acknowledged. I'll take 1hr watch and validate CDN block. ping me if any customer escalation.
sarah: closing loop - will open post-incident doc after stable. great quick coordination. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-3891 updated: status=mitigated -> monitored. Next step: postmortem owner assigned.
